title: Alternate Perspective Lore
tagline: Lore corrections for users playing with Alternate Perspective
description:
Some small lore corrections for SkyrimNet users with Alternate Perspective by KrisV777

- Adds a knowledge pack stating whether or not Helgen has been destroyed and the dragons have returned
- Corrects character bios for vanilla NPCs living in Helgen
- Adds new bios for NPCs added by Alternate Perspective
- Enables speech for The Messenger, who guides the player on a path to choose
- Identity links for Haming and The Messenger
- Dialogue Actions instruction for The Messenger's starting menu script
author: zevick
